description: Sixteen step address sequencer where each step can be skipped at random, with per-step probability and sequence reset from polyphonic inputs

params.text: The chance that a step is played rather than skipped, 0 to 100%, used for every step while nothing is patched into the probability input
Picks the order: forwards, backwards or pendulum
Sets the address space the step number is spread over, 4 to 32

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves on, skipping steps whose probability says to skip them
A rising edge restarts the sequence, reseeds the random generator from the Seed input and blocks the clock for 1ms
Sets the seed the random generator takes on a reset, so the same run of skips comes back; the seed is the voltage divided by ten and zero gives a fresh run
Sets the chance per step, one channel per step, -5V for a step that is always skipped through to 5V for a step that always plays
Sends the sequence back to its start when the step whose channel is above 1V is reached, one channel per step

outputs.text: The step the sequence has reached as a voltage, the address space spread over 0-10V

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
